summary: This configuration file sets up email filtering rules by blocking entire country-code domains and a specific company domain, then explicitly allows emails from two trusted company domains. It's a allowlist/blocklist setup where the blocklist rules are applied first to reject spam, and whitelist rules create exceptions for trusted senders.

explanations.1: This blocks all emails from any sender with a .hr (Croatia) domain extension.
explanations.2: This blocks all emails from any sender with a .rest domain extension.
explanations.3: This blocks all emails from any sender with a .ru (Russia) domain extension.
explanations.4: This blocks all emails from any sender with a .su (Soviet Union historical code) domain extension.
explanations.6: This blocks all emails from anyone with an email address at the hair.com domain, regardless of the username part before the @.
explanations.8: This overrides the blocklist and allows emails from anyone at the avonture.be company domain.
explanations.9: This allows emails from anyone at the my-own-company.com domain, ensuring internal company emails get through even if they'd otherwise be blocked.
